This is the first bail application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.215/2022, registered at Police Station- Katangi District Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376,376(2)(n), 344 of IPC & 3/4 and 5(L)/ 6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that prosecutrix is more than 17 years of age and was consenting party.

In these circumstances, applicant be released on bail.

opennyai_summary.facts:
This is the first bail application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.215/2022, registered at Police Station- Katangi District Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376,376(2)(n), 344 of IPC & 3/4 and 5(L)/ 6 of POCSO Act.
Applicant is in detention since 20.04.2023.
Prosecutrix has been examined before the trial court and she has turned hostile.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that prosecutrix is more than 17 years of age and was consenting party.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the bail application and has submitted that prosecuted is aged only 16 years and two months, therefore, her consent is immaterial.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant has opposed the prayer and has submitted that prosecutrix has turned hostile.
opennyai_summary.decision:
In these circumstances, applicant be released on bail.
She is married and she is also having one child from the wedlock.
5.
6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.
It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.
7. The applicant shall also abide by the following conditions of Section 437(3) of Cr. P. C. as under:-
(a) that such person shall attend in accordance with the conditions of the bond executed under this Chapter;
(b) that such person shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected of the commission of which he is suspected and;
(c) that such person shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
8. Certified copy as per rules.
